title: Reconfigure network interfaces
summary: Apply new configuration to specific network interfaces. Requires reloading configuration files first if they were edited.

steps.explain: Use sudo to reconfigure the specified interfaces. If you edited config files, run 'sudo networkctl reload' first.

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The name of the network interface to reconfigure.

rollback.explain: To undo, restore previous configuration, reload, and reconfigure again.

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The name of the network interface to reconfigure.

warnings: Reconfiguring may temporarily disrupt network connectivity on the specified interfaces.
